chapter_mission: Return to Coruscant; Jacen erases Ben's memory of the asteroid trip; Luke, meditating in the Temple, senses a new Sith in the Force. 'He exists.'
chapter_turn: The book closes: Jacen has crossed, Ben does not remember, Luke senses without naming — the series' engine is fully wound.

scene_plan.purpose: Ben on Coruscant without the memory of the trip; unease without object.
Luke in the Temple meditating; the new-Sith presence is sensed; 'He exists.'

exit_vector: Luke's words 'He exists' delivered to Mara; Mara already agreeing without needing clarification.
notes: The book's shortest chapter (2180 words). Its job is the close. No diminuendo — just 'he exists.'
